title: TomoClub | TAICY 2026 wrap-up: AI literacy and teamwork, by kids aged 8-15
notes: eco = the Round 1 demo video (phone, portrait). Only face-free stretches are used for the picture; v_in moves the picture there while the student's words play. The student's name (first 7 s) is never used.
r2 = the TAICY Round 2 recording. Students' Zoom tiles and names are blurred by sanitize.py; Coach VK stays sharp.
No student names, no participant numbers. Winners and entrants are congratulated as a group.

shots.text: Usually, when we hold an object to throw in the trash, it is not always obvious which trash bin to throw it into.
shots.head: TAICY Round 1 started with|a problem *they actually noticed.*

shots.text: As you can see, it classifies the tomato as a wet waste and it moves this arrow to the wet waste bin.
shots.head: So a student built a bin|that *sorts waste with AI.*

shots.text: As you can see, it classifies the mouse as electronic waste.
One of the things that I had to identify while making the app was what to let AI control and to not control.
shots.head: The real skill: deciding|what AI should *not* do.

shots.text: I use AI in the app only for

shots.title: You solved it with AI.|Now solve it *with a team.*
shots.sub: Live multiplayer strategy games · teamwork · no rulebook

shots.text: We don't give you any rules.
shots.head: No rulebook.|*Figure it out together.*

shots.text: You have to talk to each other and figure it out.
How are you doing it so fast?
shots.head: The coach asks.|*The kids think.*

shots.text: Because we remember where all the circuit pieces are, and exactly what we should do at which time.
45 seconds. You've completed it. Pretty cool.
shots.head: Lights off. Same level.|Cleared in *45 seconds.*

shots.text: Usually in other games you're competing against someone, but here you're actually working together for a certain goal.
shots.head: In their *own words.*

shots.text: So this is what game-based learning looks like.
shots.head: Game-based learning,|*the TomoClub way.*

shots.text: And I'm so proud of you.

shots.foot: Congratulations to every TAICY 2026 winner and *entrant.*
